Calculate Saturated Vapor Pressure

Source: R/leaf_wetness.R
dot-saturated_vapour_pressure.Rd

Computes saturated vapour pressure from temperature using the Alduchov and Eskridge (1996) formula, valid from -40 to +50 degrees C.

Usage

.saturated_vapour_pressure(tmp)

Arguments

tmp

Temperature (degrees C; scalar or vector).

Value

Saturated vapour pressure (kPa; scalar or vector).

Formula

es = 0.61094 * exp((17.625 * T) / (T + 243.04))

where T is temperature in degrees C and es is in kilopascals (kPa).

References

Alduchov, O. A., and R. E. Eskridge (1996). Improved Magnus form approximation of saturation vapour pressure. J. Appl. Meteor., 35: 601-609. doi:10.1175/1520-0450(1996)035<0601:IMFAOS>2.0.CO;2

Author

Adam H. Sparks

Examples

# Vapor pressure curve over typical temperature range
temps <- seq(0, 40, by = 5)
es <- .saturated_vapour_pressure(temps)
#> Error in .saturated_vapour_pressure(temps): could not find function ".saturated_vapour_pressure"
plot(temps, es, type = "b", xlab = "Temperature (degrees C)",
     ylab = "es (kPa)",
     main = "Saturated Vapor Pressure")
#> Error: object 'es' not found

# Rapid increase at higher temps (why RH drops in afternoon)
es_20 <- .saturated_vapour_pressure(20)
#> Error in .saturated_vapour_pressure(20): could not find function ".saturated_vapour_pressure"
es_30 <- .saturated_vapour_pressure(30)
#> Error in .saturated_vapour_pressure(30): could not find function ".saturated_vapour_pressure"
es_30 / es_20  # ~1.5x increase for 10 degrees C rise
#> Error: object 'es_30' not found
